title: I made a Roblox horror game
author: Financial-Meat7721
selftext:
Hey everybody! I made a Roblox horror game called **Keep Sleeping**, where you must stay asleep until 6 AM while monsters disturb you.

The game is currently in beta. It features random nighttime events, sound-based gameplay, and a story that gradually unfolds.

I'm looking for people who would be interested in trying out Keep Sleeping and helping it reach a wider audience. Since it's still in beta, every player who gives it a try helps the game grow and gain more visibility!

I'd really appreciate it if you could check it out and help spread the word!

  
[KEEP SLEEPING | Jogue na Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/pt/games/123115714982735/KEEP-SLEEPING)
